name: Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowship for New Americans
org: The Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans

eligibility.stated: Aged 30 or younger at the deadline. Naturalised US citizen, green card holder, born to non-citizen parents, born abroad and adopted by American parents, or DACA-eligible. Starting or continuing a full-time accredited graduate or professional degree in the US, and not past the second year of it.

requirements.stated: Transcripts, a resume or CV, two essays, and three to five recommendations, plus eligibility and background questions.

cycle_note: 2027 cycle, 2:00pm ET. 77 finalists interview in Jan–Feb 2027; 30 selected.
